I have implemented the file upload functionality and added complete **Edit** controls across all administrative pages.

### Highlights of the Implementation:
1. **Direct File Uploads (No URL upload required)**:
   * Added file upload selectors (`<input type="file" accept="image/*" />`) to all image-carrying forms: **Hero Slides**, **Portfolio**, and **Home Features**.
   * Selecting a local image file automatically converts it to a standard **Base64 data URL** on the fly in the browser. 
   * The converted image data is saved directly to your MongoDB database under the image fields. The browser renders these Base64 images out of the box (both locally and when deployed in production) with **zero extra cloud storage configurations required**.
   * The previous custom URL inputs remain as optional fields so you can still reference external links if needed.
2. **Full Edit (PUT) Operations**:
   * Previously, the admin forms only supported adding and deleting. I have added full Edit support to:
     * **Hero Slides** (added edit pencil icon to slide cards)
     * **Portfolio Management** (enabled the edit action inside the table)
     * **Home Features** (added edit action row)
     * **Testimonials** (added edit action row)
     * **Packages** (added edit action row)
   * Clicking **Edit** on any item loads its current values (including uploaded images) directly into the popup modal, allowing you to modify and save changes securely using standard `PUT` requests.

The local development server has hot-reloaded all changes. You can test these new upload and edit features in your browser at:
[http://localhost:3000/admin](http://localhost:3000/admin)
